summary: Priority Technology Holdings filed an 8-K disclosing a September 18, 2026 Agreement and Plan of Merger with WD Capital Partners Parent Inc. and Merger Sub, both controlled by Chairman/CEO Thomas C. Priore, the majority stockholder. Merger Sub will merge into Priority, which survives as a wholly owned subsidiary. A Special Committee of independent directors unanimously recommended the deal, and Barclays delivered a fairness opinion to the committee. The Board approved the transaction, with Priore and Crisafulli recusing. The excerpt omits price, premium, and closing conditions, so economics remain unspecified pending later filings. Watch for proxy disclosure of merger consideration, rollover shares, go-shop, and appraisal-rights language.
